column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Institute  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to develop the profession of landscape architecture
in Sri Lanka to internationally accepted standards;
to provide leadership and guidance to the profession
and to facilitate the profession in fulfilling its vital
role  in  the  process  of  sustainable  development,
integrating  natural  systems  and  applying  relevant
arts and sciences in service to society.
The functions of the Institute shall be—
to promote and advance the study of, practice and

application  of,  and  research 
in, 
landscape
architecture  and  its  related  subjects  and  the  arts
